sources.title: Independent block/collision/crop/position derivation
sources.details: A full bright column has32 ones. Each touched8×8 block has8 ones, so8/64=0.125; four blocks survive below0.5. Columns8 and15 in the same width block have equal block averages but different pixels; a function of their shared output cannot uniquely invert both. Window coordinates map(u,v) to(x0+u,y0+v). Patch count N=HW/P², and Qwen spatial2×2 merge divides count by4. See independent-findings.md and independent Python loop output for substitution and scope.
